data.description:
## Context / Problem
Two tests added by 863abe7cd19 (rubbery-adamantine-panda) fail in every Windows sweep since: tests/unit/metrics/test_git_metrics.py::test_oracle_cap_change_events_compares_unsampled_adjacent_revisions and ::test_history_walk_cat_file_starts_do_not_grow_with_revisions, both at `git fast-import --quiet --export-marks=...` returned non-zero exit status 128 (helper `_fast_import_history`, tests/unit/metrics/test_git_metrics.py:220-250). Seen in tmp-branch runs 44900392763 and 44900397644 (2026-11-21 PST, trees on origin/main 1a11014a3a4). They block a green main `sweep (windows)`, which breezy-hogged-mastiff needs to close.

## Hypothesis (unverified)
The helper passes the stream as text (`input="..."` with text mode), so on Windows each \\n is written to git's stdin as \\r\\n, while each `data <n>` count is the byte length with \\n only. fast-import then reads past or short of each data block and aborts. Check: rerun with stderr captured, or feed `input=...encode('utf-8')` without text mode, on a Windows run.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both tests pass in a `sweep (windows)` run (run id recorded in a comment) with the cause recorded on this ticket.
data.title: Windows sweep: test_git_metrics fast-import history helper fails with exit 128
